source.note: suite-local profile (docs/10), no Trust Tasks home; channel candidate per decision 79 by the project owner (supersedes 78's proposed)

vectors.clarify: The witness-share profile says a receiver SHOULD be idempotent on the credential digest (docs/10 section 8: one stored credential, a receipt each time). The framework does not decide the case: a redelivery under a new id is a different document, so SPEC.md 7.2 item 11 (SPEC.md:1021, 1033) does not apply. The vector asserts the SHOULD as a requirement (one stored credential after the second delivery). Not gating.
